adjudication.rationale:
In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`:
```ts
const isTeamAdminOrOwner =
  (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) &&
  (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0));
```
This requires the user to be BOTH a team admin and a team owner, contradicting the `AdminOrOwner` naming and likely intended authorization (“admin OR owner”). As written, a user who is only an admin (or only an owner) would fail this branch and could be incorrectly denied unless they match `isOrganizer`/`isAttendee`.
